body.title: Finish concise coverage, exact scope and honest result reporting
body.summary: Complete grouped expectation presentation and accepted-state inconclusive reports, capture canonical BUILD reviewScope from tracked changes, preserve BUILD/TESTS identity/history and original test outcomes, and wire configured default routing for new starts. Keep old engine-bound sessions and approved ISSUE scope readers.
acceptanceChecks: Grouping preserves explicit member applicability, evidence and all authoritative obligations; no omitted member inherits a pass. Missing coverage produces a useful regenerable /tmp report, never a complete CR or automatic BUILD approval.

Canonical BUILD reviewScope pins full source/commit/parent/block/task provenance from daemon-tracked changes. Mixed/unprovable attribution requires explicit selection; no trailer-only or generic HEAD inference is accepted.
TESTS regeneration preserves repo identity, lifecycle/history and original per-Task commit/ranAt/results. Uniquely resolved abbreviated IDs must identify the same Git object.

Reuse existing derived TrustedInspectionReceipt.testResult unknown with partial completeness and limitation for source-unbound results. Never add unknown to persisted TESTS case outcomes or turn metadata repair into passing evidence.

New normal review starts honor configured engine and admission policy; old tokens retain admitted engine/protocol. Legacy/design-review routes and status readers remain compatible. Default stays legacy during build.

tests.name: compact groups: explicit member applicability, provenance and unresolved coverage
inconclusive finish: useful temporary report without complete CR or BUILD approval
canonical BUILD scope: exact daemon-captured commits/parents/blocks; ambiguous attribution refuses
canonical TESTS regeneration: repo/history and original results preserved; unbound derived receipt remains unknown
review entrypoint routing: configured new starts, bound old tokens and legacy/design compatibility
